company.name: Dealat
company.shortDescription: Dealat encourages people to try a different store each day by offering special deals and discounted prices.
company.description:
Dealat encourages people to try a different store each day by offering special deals and discounted prices.

Dealat is the marketplace of deals. The products and services listed on the mobile application are offered at huge discounts and are referred to as deals. Dealat creates value through the low prices it offers but also through the convenience and accessibility of the wide-range of deals we provide. Our initial value proposition is to help local businesses introduce people to their businesses, thus allowing companies to acquire future potential clients.

productsAndServices.description: A digital platform and mobile application that provides users access to a variety of discounted deals and offers across multiple service categories.
productsAndServices.name: Dealaat Platform and Mobile App

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables businesses to create, manage, and promote discount deals to attract new customers through the Dealaat platform.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $422,535, or 80.86% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $200,000 to $2,112,675, a 10.56x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Groupon, LivingSocial, Slickdeals.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
